question.text: As per SEBI Circular dated July 31, 2025, the Digital Platforms provided by AIFs to their investors shall be:

answer.text: Compliant with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and corresponding rules.
Available only in English language on a nationally hosted server.
Restricted to domestic resident investors only.
Audited by a SEBI-registered cyber-security firm quarterly.

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook records that SEBI notified all Digital Platforms provided by AIFs to their investors shall comply with the provisions of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and corresponding rules. The stated objective is to facilitate increased participation of persons with disabilities in the securities markets. The Trap: Options B, C, and D state language-only access, residency restrictions, and a fixed cyber-security audit cadence that are not part of the digital-platform requirement set out on the page checked. Note: Per workbook page 92.
